desc: path assembled from a shell variable at runtime
why: the path does not exist as a literal string in the command

desc: path assembled by string concatenation inside another language

why: the command name is not a literal either

desc: keychain read through a language binding rather than the cli
why: does not go through the security binary at all

desc: an environment dump run through secret run
why: secret run is exempt; the child inherits the agent's whole environment and only the named keys and known shapes are scrubbed

desc: a token captured under an innocent name and printed later
why: the variable name does not look secret, and the guard does not follow values between commands

desc: a secret variable whose name does not look secret
why: printing one variable is judged by its name alone

desc: a pod spec with an inline environment value
why: pod specs usually reference secrets rather than hold them, so the guard lets them through

desc: a script file run by a shell
why: the guard sees the file's name, not what it holds

desc: a secret variable expanded in an unquoted heredoc body
why: heredoc bodies are checked for substitutions, not for variables
